page.overview:
What is Eight-legged pig-like creature?

An unidentified species of eight-legged pig-like creature was native to G-435, where it was prey to s. It was fairly docile and friendly towards humans.

The creature possessed a large head that somewhat resembled an Earthen hog, with small triangular ears and bulbous blue eyes. featured a black saddle marking in the middle of its back and sat on eight skinny legs, protruding from its sides and terminating in blunt claws. It had a small curly tail and moved in a trot.

Much like the Earth pigs it somewhat resembled, the creature communicated with a series of oinks and high-pitched grunts.

The creature was curious and non-aggressive in nature, snuffling around foreign objects and creatures, even allowing humans to pet it, which it seemed to enjoy. It also seemed to lack a particularly strong survival instinct, sticking around and watching when predators attacked other creatures and humans fired gunshots.
